question: Related Questions Q. What is the meaning of "Maulana"? To whom can we call "Maulan"? 2460 views Q. In my dream, I saw myself in a school, where I saw a couple of children coming out of classrooms wearing back uniforms on. As I was walking, I found myself walking towards this room. The buldingb was very quiet, it was not loud or noisy as most schools are. When I walked into the room, I found my friend sitting down with a child. (Please note, my friend is not married)When I saw her in my dream she was holding a beautiful baby boy. He had bright blonde and black hair. Black hair at the bottom, not very visible and blonde hair on the top, it was very bright. When I approached my friend, the baby boy that she was holding was not in her control. He kept fiddling around. He almost like a hyperactive child. I put my hands forward to pick him up, when i picked him up, i held him for a couple of seconds, and then i gave him back to my friend. Once i gave him back, he fell asleep really quickly. I know this sounds weird brother, but please help me with the meaning of this dream. Ps.. I have sent you a couple of questions before too. Please could you get back to me about those and could you also make sure my answers are written back to me in english? 1399 views Q. I had seen a dream some 10 years back.At that time my parents had gone for hajj.I was suffering from maleria with high fever and body pain.My brother, sister and uncle were at home.After dinner we all went to sleep, I was having very high pain in my body & i was not able to sleep. I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. I asked my uncle about the 2 person & he told me that i must have seen a dream but i could not believe it because it was so real. But i could not recollect the faces of the 2 persons. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. 1781 views Q. Is it ok to do study after Asar salah? 7842 views Q.
